Write a heading with a background image

pptx_section_slide.Rd

In PowerPoint output, returns a heading with a background image, for section or title slides. In other formats it returns a plain heading, or nothing if include_html = FALSE.

The image is looked up in bg_dir by file name without its extension. It can be named after the heading level (level1.png or 1.png) or after bg. Exactly one file must match. Make the image the same size as your slides.

Usage

pptx_section_slide(level = 1, title, bg = NULL, include_html = TRUE, bg_dir)

Arguments

level

Heading level: 1 for #, 2 for ## and so on. Defaults to 1.

title

The heading text.

bg

Optional. The image's file name without the extension, for example "blue" for blue.png.

include_html

Logical. If FALSE, write nothing when the output isn't PowerPoint. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_dir

The folder that holds the background images.

Value

The heading, ready to print in a chunk with output: asis, or NULL.

See also

Other PowerPoint: add_pptx_backgrounds_to_headers(), auto_slide_break(), insert_slide_break(), pptx_col_start(), slide_break()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pptx_section_slide(level = 1, title = "Results", bg = "blue", bg_dir = "backgrounds")
} # }
